# Canteen Rush - Smart Campus Dining & Queue Management

> Canteen Rush is a modern web application built for university campuses to streamline food pre-ordering, provide live counter wait-time analytics, and eliminate dining queues through instant digital token workflows and campus wallet payments.

## Core Features

- [Campus Canteens](https://canteen-rush.web.app/): Live directory of all university dining halls and kiosks including Ivy Hall, Christ Bakery, Nandini Parlour, Gourmet Central, Mingos, and Block IV Court.
- [Explore & Search](https://canteen-rush.web.app/explore): Global search across all campus outlets, curated categories (<5m Express, Brews & Shakes, Hot Crispy Snacks, Healthy & Fresh, Pizzas, Desserts), and diet filters (Veg / Non-Veg).
- [Campus Wallet](https://canteen-rush.web.app/wallet): Cashless digital ledger supporting zero-delay payments, pass management, and balance top-ups.
- [Live Order Tracking](https://canteen-rush.web.app/orders): WebSocket-driven live order status, preparation countdown, and digital pickup tokens.
- [Campus Location Map](https://canteen-rush.web.app/location): Interactive campus map marking all food outlet spots, floor locations, and current opening hours.

## Outlets & Canteens

- [Ivy Hall](https://canteen-rush.web.app/canteen/ivy-hall): Under Main Auditorium. Fast food, burgers, wraps, hakka noodles, and cold beverages.
- [Christ University Bakery](https://canteen-rush.web.app/canteen/christ-bakery): Near Central Block. Fresh patties, rolls, iconic Pazham Pori banana fritters, and pastries.
- [Nandini Milk Parlour](https://canteen-rush.web.app/canteen/nandini): Near Sports Ground. Fresh dairy shakes, kulfis, badam milk, and ice creams.
- [Birds Park Kiosk](https://canteen-rush.web.app/canteen/birds-park-kiosk): Garden pathway. Quick wraps, sandwiches, hot coffee, and snacks.
- [Gourmet Extension](https://canteen-rush.web.app/canteen/gourmet-ext): Block II Courtyard. Continental platters, loaded bowls, smoothies, and juices.
- [Block IV Court](https://canteen-rush.web.app/canteen/block-iv): Block IV Ground Floor. Woodfired pizzas, pastas, south Indian meals, and parottas.
- [Fresh & Healthy Cafe](https://canteen-rush.web.app/canteen/fresh-cafe): Near Fitness Center. Protein salads, cold-pressed juices, and healthy smoothie bowls.

## API & Endpoints

- [Canteens API](https://canteen-rush.web.app/api/canteens): Retrieve all registered canteen entities, operational status, wait-times, and menus.
- [Explore Products API](https://canteen-rush.web.app/api/products/explore): Query dishes by name, category, or dietary preference.
- [Real-Time WebSocket Gateway](https://canteen-rush.web.app/socket.io): Socket.IO events for `new_order`, `order_status_updated`, and live kitchen tokens.
- [Vendor Portal](https://canteen-rush.web.app/admin): Administrative dashboard for order queues, dish availability toggles, and revenue analytics.
